The post Cardone Capital Adds 1,200 BTC and 2,000 Units in $5.3B Real Estate Appro...
content:
Key Takeaways:

  • Cardone Capital has been allocating approximately 1,200 BTC and 2,000 multifamily units through its hybrid real estate-Bitcoin approach.
  • The company reinvests the Bitcoin at regular intervals, even when the price is low, from property rentals.
  • Grant Cardone is aiming to reach 10,000 BTC total in 10 specialized investment funds.

Grant Cardone is advancing on Bitcoin’s path with an investment approach that entails both crypto investing and real estate investing to generate income. This latest addition brings in about 1,200 BTC and some 2,000 multifamily units, further solidifying the firm’s push for the two-asset model.

  • Cardone Doubles Down on Bitcoin and Real Estate
  • Rental Cash Flow Fuels Bitcoin Purchases
    • 10,000 BTC Remains the Long-Term Target
    • Investors Face Dual-Market Exposure

Cardone Doubles Down on Bitcoin and Real Estate

Cardone said in an Aug. 28 X post that Cardone Capital was “doubling down” on its multifamily and Bitcoin model, with the latest expansion covering approximately 2,000 apartments and 1,200 BTC.

“While Institutions pivot to data centers Cardone Capital double downs on Multi-Family/BTC model, adding ~2000 units and 1200 BTC. pic.twitter.com/MIURtpMIST

— Grant Cardone (@GrantCardone) August 28, 2026

He did not disclose the purchase price, transaction dates or the specific funds that received the assets. With this statement alone, you cannot determine the precise amount of Bitcoin Cardone Capital now controls after its latest transaction.

The roadmap involves incorporating Bitcoin into private investment funds that are accompanied by income-generating real estate. With the exception of fresh cap raises, the firm plans to store a portion of the cash brought in from rentals to build up some BTC.

Read More: Mirae Asset Targets $109B Crypto Empire With Stablecoins and Tokenized Assets

Rental Cash Flow Fuels Bitcoin Purchases

Cardone has called it the dollar cost averaging strategy. The money continues to buy Bitcoin at a variety of market prices, such as when BTC drops. This results in a model that differs from traditional corporate Bitcoin treasuries, with many firms borrowing or selling shares to buy cryptocurrency.

10,000 BTC Remains the Long-Term Target

Cardone’s newest 1,200 BTC investment is part of his strategy for 10 specialized investing funds that will eventually total 10,000 BTC.

The company has already made several big-bet investments in Bitcoin. Previously, Cardone had said that he prefers to buy BTC when the price drops, which involves him buying millions of dollars worth during market downturns.

The strategy also provides rental properties with a second purpose of generating returns. Their cash flow could be a regular source of money for buying Bitcoins.

Investors Face Dual-Market Exposure

The model also creates risks across both markets. However, if there is a major Bitcoin crash, the crypto allocation may decline in value, and if the house is empty or under maintenance or the rents are low, it could mean less cash is available to buy BTC in the future.

Investors in Cardone’s private capital do not own the actual Bitcoin in the vehicles either. Their exposure is subject to the specifics and structure of each investment fund, which may be restricted with liquidity and withdrawals.

This is a strategy that is entirely different from purchasing the coins outright or owning a spot Bitcoin ETF. Cardone Capital investors are actually exposure-risking property performance as well as Bitcoin prices in a single invested structure.

title: Ripple Donates $300K to Flood Relief in Nepal and Tibet Through WCK, Mercy Corps
summary:

content:
Key Takeaways:

  • Ripple is giving $300,000 to World Central Kitchen and Mercy Corps for the devastating floods in Nepal and Tibet.
  • Funds will be raised to provide emergency meals, water, sanitation and relief measures in impacted communities.
  • More than one hundred people dead and hundreds missing or unreachable in flash floods in Nepal’s North.

In response to the devastating floods in Nepal and in the Tibetan region, Ripple is actively responding to the crisis. The company stated its $300,000 contribution would assist two leading relief groups bring immediate response on the ground.

  • Ripple Commits $300K to Flood Relief
  • Catastrophic Flooding Hits Northern Nepal
    • Glacier-Linked Surge Destroyed Infrastructure
    • WCK and Mercy Corps Lead Emergency Response

Ripple Commits $300K to Flood Relief

Ripple revealed the donation in its official X account, specifying that it will provide $300,000 to World Central Kitchen (WCK) and Mercy Corps.

Our thoughts are with those impacted by the devastating floods in Nepal and Tibet.🇳🇵

Ripple is donating $300,000 to @WCKitchen and @MercyCorps to support emergency meal distribution and water and sanitation efforts on the ground.

— Ripple (@Ripple) August 28, 2026

The contribution will help aid in emergency food distribution and water and sanitation efforts to those impacted by the disaster. Ripple also urged the rest of the community to lend a helping hand through donations direct to the two organizations, to continue the relief effort.

The relocation also brings a humanitarian edge to Ripple’s increasingly diversified profile in the cryptocurrency space, which has been spending more of its resources in the area of disaster response and charitable efforts.

Read More: Ripple CTO Holds XRP Only After Massive Gains, Warns Crypto Investors to Sell Some

Catastrophic Flooding Hits Northern Nepal

It has been especially severe in Rasuwa and Nuwakot districts of Nepal, where rivers in the border region with China have flooded communities downstream.

WCK officials stated that World Central Kitchen restaurant partners are already delivering meals to impacted communities and that their relief team will be soon on the ground to boost the response.

Glacier-Linked Surge Destroyed Infrastructure

Experts said they think an avalanche of ice and rock, from a glacier on the Lhende Khola River, which is a tributary of the Bhotekoshi, blocked the river before a big wave of water rushed down.

Villages were washed away, and vital infrastructure suffered damages. Roads, bridges and power systems have all suffered significantly resulting in some communities being cut off and making delivering background help and support more challenging.

The disaster also pinpoints the disaster-prone parts of river corridor communities of Bhote Koshi and Trishuli, which is the second major flood event in the river in 14 months.

WCK and Mercy Corps Lead Emergency Response

Through its local restaurant partners, World Central Kitchen is working to provide food assistance needs in the present. It is going to do our best to deliver food to the communities where flood has hampered food access.

Mercy Corps is working to bridge the gaps with local and humanitarian groups to address immediate needs and assist in emergency response efforts.

The organization has been active in Nepal since 2005, in the past focusing on earthquake, flood and landslide related work on disaster response and preparedness.

Ripple’s investments are therefore targeted at immediate and functional requirements: feeding families in need of food after an ongoing humanitarian emergency, while at the same time making an impact on access to clean water and sanitation.

title: Nillion’s Dusk Launches Encrypted Markets, Hiding $50K ETH Trades Until Triggered
summary:
Key Takeaways: Nillion has announced Dusk, the first milestone on its seven-step roadmap to Encrypted Markets on the Sepolia testnet. To hide conditional trading instructions until specific price and/or time
The post Nillion’s Dusk Launches Encrypted Markets, Hiding $50K ETH Trades Until Triggered a...
content:
Key Takeaways:

  • Nillion has announced Dusk, the first milestone on its seven-step roadmap to Encrypted Markets on the Sepolia testnet.
  • To hide conditional trading instructions until specific price and/or time triggers, dusk employs encrypted Covenants.
  • It includes selected crypto assets and conditions that can last up to 30 days, with the Ethereum mainnet planned for release at the end of September.

Nillion is bringing a new privacy layer to onchain trading with Dusk, a system designed to hide a trader’s instructions before they are ready to execute.

https://t.co/6lGA3tM3nj

— Nillion (@nillion) August 28, 2026

  • Dusk Introduces Encrypted Covenants
  • A $50,000 ETH Trade Triggered by BTC
    • Hidden Instructions Target Onchain Information Leakage
    • Ethereum Mainnet Rollout Planned for September

Dusk Introduces Encrypted Covenants

Dusk is the first live phase of Nillion’s seven-stage Encrypted Markets roadmap. Built around Ethereum, it introduces Covenants, which allow users to create conditional instructions and post them onchain in encrypted form.

A trader can pre-save an action and trigger it based on a price level and a future time period. In such a state, the instruction is sealed and observers will note that there is an encrypted Covenant present, but they will not be able to visualize what is inside. When the trigger is reached, Nillion’s decentralized nodes are there to help un-lock on chain the instruction for it to settle.

The system does not rely on a single operator to decide when an instruction becomes accessible. But, once posted, Covenants are not cancelable. An instruction that doesn’t happen at all can expire without being publicized.

A $50,000 ETH Trade Triggered by BTC

Nillion explained an example of cross asset trading. A trader could prepare an order to buy $50,000 worth of ETH when BTC reaches $80,000. As long as Bitcoin is not at that level, the ETH trading instruction is still encrypted on chain.

If the BTC reaches the target, it triggers and the instruction can be unlocked. The trigger can be different to the asset that is eventually traded. This may help traders develop more advanced conditional strategies than regular stop or limit orders.

Read More: Ethereum Faces Brutal Oil Correlation as Tom Lee Sees Massive 2026 ETH Rebound

Hidden Instructions Target Onchain Information Leakage

The initial release of Dusk features price-based conditions for a select list of crypto assets as well as a 30-day window. It has already tested a sealed stop mechanism end to end, which means a stop level will not be visible until activated, Nillion said. The same infrastructure has been used for a sealed bid auction also.

This is to prevent intentions to trade from becoming apparent before they happen. In a transparent blockchain, public exposure of orders or strategies may provide information for other participants which can allow trading in advance of the initial order. At that time, dusk tries to preserve that same information.

Ethereum Mainnet Rollout Planned for September

The Sepolia testnet has been released on Dusk. The first applications powered by Dusk will be available on testnet before mid-September, Nillion expects. The project plans to deploy its contracts to Ethereum mainnet, with node network bootstrapping expected to follow, as of late September.

Dusk is the initial milestone of Nillion’s Encrypted Markets vision, embedding the project’s core principle: that trade instructions remain encrypted onchain until they are ready to be executed.

  • The company has a total of 43,000 BTC worth almost $3.48 billion.
  • The transfer has brought into focus institutional Bitcoin treasury management again.

Metaplanet has moved another large batch of Bitcoin, drawing fresh attention from crypto investors tracking corporate BTC accumulation strategies. According to blockchain analytics platform Lookonchain, the Japanese Bitcoin-focused company recently deposited 1,350 BTC, valued at around $108 million, into Coinbase Prime.

Bitcoin miner Metaplanet (@Metaplanet), which bought 43,000 $BTC($3.48B) at an average price of $96,191, deposited another 1,350 $BTC ($108M) into Coinbase Prime an hour ago.https://t.co/HGljOETBsX pic.twitter.com/JimnSZu2k7

— Lookonchain (@lookonchain) August 28, 2026

The company’s purchase of 43,000 BTC is one of the biggest corporate firms in the world, and it’s the move and purchase on an average behind the $96,191 price point per BTC.

  • Metaplanet Transfers 1,350 BTC to Coinbase Prime
  • Corporate Bitcoin Holdings Continue to Expand
    • Why Coinbase Prime Is Commonly Used
    • Bitcoin Treasury Race Gains Momentum

Metaplanet Transfers 1,350 BTC to Coinbase Prime

According to on-chain data shared by stakeholders-revealing platform Lookonchain, just about one hour prior to the report release, Metaplanet moved 1350 BTC to Coinbase Prime. The transferred Monero was worth about $108 million based on market rates as of the date of the transaction.

The transfer comes after a succession of some extremely aggressive acquisition bids, making Metaplanet one of the most intriguing public digital asset firms in action. Today, the firm’s reported treasury includes 43,000 BTC, bringing the overall value of the acquisitions to approximately $3.48 billion.

There is also a significant potential for large transfers to be noticed because Coinbase Prime is popular among asset managers, corporations, institutional investors, and public companies for custody, execution and treasury services.

Read More: Metaplanet Pours 2,100 BTC Worth $132M Into Superplanet for a U.S. Bitcoin Push

Corporate Bitcoin Holdings Continue to Expand

Metaplanet is a notable example of the emerging trend in the world of corporations using Bitcoin as a treasury asset. On the bright side, a handful of publicly listed companies are starting to dedicate part of their balance sheets to Bitcoin, following the example of such companies as Strategy (formerly MicroStrategy).

The mean price per unit of acquisition looks like $96,191, which implies that it’s buying chunks of coins during Bitcoin’s recent bull market. For a majority of 2026, Bitcoin has been trading above, and Metaplanet currently holds one of the biggest institutional positions in Bitcoin.

Why Coinbase Prime Is Commonly Used

Just because there’s a transfer to Coinbase Prime, it doesn’t imply a sell. Institutional entities often custody, provide collateral, engage in over-the-counter trading, provision of loans or portfolio rebalancing on the platform.

Due to the nature of the work of Coinbase Prime which deals with large trading and processing amounts, that usually means that the deposits of a substantial amount of BTC are not necessarily functioning in the market.

Bitcoin Treasury Race Gains Momentum

The latest transfer highlights the scale at which corporate Bitcoin adoption is now operating. A single movement of 1,350 BTC represents more than $100 million in digital assets, yet it accounts for only a small fraction of Metaplanet’s overall holdings.

As more public companies continue to accumulate Bitcoin, on-chain movements from major treasury holders are increasingly becoming key indicators for market participants. While the purpose behind this specific transfer remains undisclosed, the transaction underscores the growing sophistication of institutional Bitcoin management and the expanding role of regulated crypto infrastructure providers in supporting large corporate treasuries.
